symptom: native Signature, Bottom sheet and Maps (Native Mobile Resources 12.6.0) created by mxcli failed mx check 11.13.0 with CE0463 on every instance
cause: the definition generated from the .mpk differed from mx update-widgets in three attributes: AllowUpload false where the image property declares allowUpload="true" (not parsed at all); OnChangeProperty "" where the attribute declares onChange (parsed, but createDefaultValueType hard-coded ""); an enumeration caption trimmed where Mendix stores the element text verbatim, trailing newline and indentation included
fix: parse allowUpload; write p.AllowUpload and p.OnChange into the generated ValueType and sync AllowUpload onto augmented templates; keep the raw caption beside the trimmed one and write the raw one
insight: mx check runs on macOS through Docker: debian:bookworm-slim plus libicu72, libuuid1, libfreetype6, fontconfig, with LD_PRELOAD of libuuid.so.1 and libfreetype.so.6 (libSkiaSharp does not link uuid). A baseline mx check of the untouched fixture is what separates the 4 new CE0463 from the 105 the fixture already had
